title: Realme 16 Pro  Harry Potter Edition teased
description: Last year, Realme teamed up with Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products for the Realme 15 Pro Game of Thrones Limited Edition. Today, the company announced another partnership with Warner Bros. for a Realme 16 Pro limited edition, inspired by the Harry Potter universe. The Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition is expected to have the same hardware as the standard models, but come with a different design and richer retail package. The smartphone's right frame has "Welcome to Hogwarts" written on it. Realme will reveal more details shortly, but it already confirmed it...

title: Honor Magic9 series to debut on September 28, design revealed
description: Honor has announced the launch date for its upcoming Magic9 flagship series. Alongside, it has revealed the phones’ design and highlighted some of their key camera features. The lineup is also available for pre-order in China. The Honor Magic9 series will debut in China on September 28, the company confirmed in a post on Weibo. Honor has not revealed how many models will launch as part of the lineup, although a recent leak claimed that the company could unveil the Magic9 alongside the Magic9 Pro or Magic9 Pro Max. The launch teasers also confirm that the phone will feature a dual...

title: Tecno Camon Slim unboxing
description: Say hello to the latest in Tecno's line of slim phones - the Camon Slim 5G. It's similar, yet different from the 4G Camon Slim, and they shouldn't be mistaken (though they surely will). We've got the phone as well as Tecno's quirky MagBadge accessory alongside it. Let's unbox them, but first, if you want a video presentation of the Tecno Camon Slim 5G, check out our TikTok! The phone ships in a well-stocked box with a clear hard case with MagSafe, a 45W charger, a USB-A cable, and a tempered glass screen protector. And yes, the screen protector is a nice touch, but it's pretty close to...

title: Samsung Galaxy A55 gets One UI 9 Beta update
description: Samsung has rolled out the One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy A55. The One UI 9 beta for the Samsung Galaxy A55 requires a download of over 2GB and comes with firmware versions ending in ZZI1/EZI1 in South Korea and ZZI1/EZI2 in India. It also comes with the September 2026 security patch. If you want to try One UI 9 beta on your Galaxy A55 before its stable release, enroll in the One UI 9 Beta program through the Samsung Members app, then navigate to your phone's Settings > Software update menu to check for the update. title: Honor will finally unveil MagicOS 11 next week
description: We thought Honor would fully unveil MagicOS 11 based on Android 17 in August, but that didn't happen. Now, the company has announced that it will finally be doing so next week, on September 15, during its Global Developer Conference. In fact, MagicOS 11 will be the star of the show. According to Honor, we can expect a refreshed UI (with heavy inspiration from iOS and its Liquid Glass design language), improved charging (not sure what that means), and an enhanced storage cleanup feature. Unsurprisingly, AI will be a big part of the update, with Honor saying the software will be...

title: Oppo A7 Pro is now official with an 8,000 mAh battery
description: Oppo's A7 Pro is finally joining the A7 Pro Max, which was launched back in August. The A7 Pro will become available in China on September 11, and ahead of that the company has started taking pre-orders for the device today, also revealing its specs and pricing in the process. The A7 Pro has a 6.57-inch flat OLED screen with 1080x2372 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,400-nit peak brightness, a 50MP main camera with f/1.9 aperture, an 8MP front camera with f/2.1 aperture, and an 8,000 mAh battery with support for 45W fast wired charging. title: We go hands-on with TCL P80 Pro's OLED-based NxtPaper display, TCL P80 also handled
description: TCL made a big jump with the P80 series of phones – these are the first to have NxtPaper displays based on OLED panels instead of LCD. The key benefits are the usual – higher brightness, greater contrast, punchier colors – but the company made sure that these advantages didn’t come at the cost of a reduced NxtPaper experience. The NxtPaper brand has been around for a few years now – it aims to give the display a paper-like feel and comfort when reading. Yes, e-ink displays exist and there are even some e-ink phones out there. However, despite years of improving frame rates and colors,...

title: MediaTek's Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC now has an official launch date
description: Today on X, MediaTek has revealed when it plans to unveil its next flagship Dimensity SoC: on September 15 at 2:30 PM in China. That's 2:30 AM in New York, 7:30 AM in London, 8:30 AM in Central Europe, 9:30 AM in Eastern Europe, and 12 PM in India. According to the post on X, the new product is a "pro chip", enabling a "pro experience", but it also comes with "pro efficiency" and "pro imaging", supporting 4k240fps slow-motion. "Pro gaming" hasn't been forgotten either, with the company promising "AI-enhanced graphics", an upgraded HyperEngine, and "immersive ray tracing". So it...

title: Apple wanted the iPhone Ultra to cost $1,999, new report says
description: Apple is holding its big annual iPhone launch event on September 9, and it's widely expected to unveil the iPhone Ultra on that day. This will be its first foldable smartphone, and it's been a very long time coming. According to a new report from Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the company has practically been working on it for a decade. Interestingly, Apple wanted the iPhone Ultra to cost $1,999, but it got hit by the memory chip shortage and insane price hikes, so now it's probably going to come out starting at $2,199. However, the top configuration (presumably with 1TB of storage) might go as...

title: iOS camera app will get some pro add-ons, hints at variable aperture support
description: Apple is finalizing iOS 27 for release to the masses (after tomorrow's iPhone 18 event), and some clever people have peeked into the code to see what's new. Specifically, the iOS 27 camera app code, and there are some major pro features en route. Starting with exposure scopes, bringing tools like a histogram and waveform to judge exposure. Both have a more sophisticated RGB (red, green, blue) version for finer control. So far the camera app has had an exposure value slider, which was anything but pro. Next up is manual focus and focus peaking, which will enable much finer...

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE review
The iPhone Ultra launch in China may be delayed for the same reason as the iPhone Air
description: The iPhone 15 models sold in the US exclusively used eSIM – in the US, Apple’s move away from physical SIMs went off without a hitch. The story in China was different, though. The iPhone Air was the first eSIM-only model to be sold in China and it faced delays over compliance issues. That was a year ago, but it sounds like Apple is headed for another troubled launch – the Chinese launch of the foldable iPhone Ultra will be delayed compared to other markets, reports Instant Digital on Weibo. Instant points to issues with the iPhone Air – activation, replacement and transfer of eSIMs...

description: Motorola launched the Signature back in January, and now the company is already starting its teaser campaign for the successor called Signature 27. When you visit Motorola.com from the European Union or the UK, you'll get a pop-up on the main homepage that shows a glimpse of the upcoming phone, which you can see below. [#InlinePriceWidget,14397,1#] You can register your interest in the device right there and then, giving Motorola permission to email you with more details when it's ready to reveal them. title: Poco C95 Pro videos show it in three colors, pricing is out too
description: Yesterday the Poco C95 Pro leaked for the first time. Its specs and some renders were outed on that occasion, and today we already have two short videos showing the phone and its box, and we also have a price leak this time around. So according to this, the model with 6 GB of RAM and 128 GB of storage will cost $220, while the one with 8 GB of RAM and 256 GB of storage will go for $260. The box is the traditional Poco yellow as you might have expected, while the phones are being shown in three different colors, one of which is the green that seems to have a fake leather back. One of...

title: Our Google Pixel 11 battery life and charging tests are ready
description: Last year, the Pixel 10 delivered less-than-stellar battery life results from its 4,970mAh battery – this was the first generation with Tensor chipsets fabbed by TSMC, so, clearly, there were some teething issues. It’s a year later and we’re putting the Google Pixel 11 through the same battery and charging tests. Google kept battery capacity essentially the same at 4,985mAh, but it optimized the rest of the hardware to reduce power draw. Let’s find out whether it was successful. Indeed it was! With an Active Use Score of 15:40h, the Pixel 11 left its predecessor in the dust – the 2025...

title: Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 Pro series' India launch date confirmed, packs a 10,000 mAh battery
description: Xiaomi unveiled the Redmi Note 17 Pro in China in July and later introduced it globally in August alongside the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max. It started teasing the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max in India last week, and today the company said the Redmi Note 17 Pro series will debut in India on September 15. When strength meets power, you get a mAhster. Meet the all-new #REDMINote17ProSeries. A powerhouse that pushes limits, takes on more and raises the bar. The #mAhsterOfStrength arrives on 15th September, 2026. Get notified: https://t.co/M54WEAYbgA pic.twitter.com/hJTK9JH0dk— Redmi India (@RedmiIndia)...

title: iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra to debut this month, pre-orders go live
description: The iQOO 16 launch has been officially teased, with the company also confirming that an iQOO Pad Ultra is also coming soon. Both devices are already available for pre-order in China. In a post on Weibo, the vivo sub-brand revealed that the iQOO 16 and iQOO Pad Ultra will debut in China toward the end of this month. While the company has not shared any specifications for the upcoming devices, it has given us a glimpse of their designs. The iQOO 16 teaser is seen with the redesigned rear camera module that leaked last week. Meanwhile, the iQOO Pad Ultra teaser reveals a...

title: It's official - the Oppo F35 series is launching in India soon
description: Oppo has officially confirmed that the F35 series will launch in India soon. This launch was rumored back in August – back then, the scuttlebutt was that the F35 models will launch alongside the Find X9s Pro. However, Oppo is still mum on that part. As for the Oppo F35 models, we’ve heard of at least two – the Oppo F35 Pro and the F35 Pro Max (note that the actual names may be different). Alas, the teasers only show anonymous silhouettes, so we can’t tell how many phones there actually are in the series. The August rumors claimed that the F35 Pro Max will be a re-branded Oppo A7 Pro...

title: Xiaomi 18 Fold hands-on
description: Passport-sized folds are the trend these days, and the freshly announced Xiaomi 18 Fold wants to capitalize on the momentum. We already brought you an “eyes-on” preview from the Xiaomi showbooth at IFA 2026, and we can now share our first impressions after spending some quality time with the device. Right off the bat, the 18 Fold feels decently light considering the 7.58-inch folding display. Xiaomi’s numbers claim 219 grams, placing the 18 Fold in the same weight class as the Xiaomi 17 Ultra but a cool 18 grams heavier than the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8. And yes, we managed to snap some...

title: OnePlus N6 Lite teased
description: OnePlus has officially teased the launch of a new N6 series smartphone in India. The upcoming OnePlus N6 Lite will join the N6 and N6x, and is expected to be the most affordable model in the lineup. While OnePlus has yet to announce an official launch date, a tipster claims that the N6 Lite could be unveiled toward the end of this month and may come with 4GB of RAM. The official teaser for the upcoming phone offers a partial look at its front design.
